failing.summary: CHANGELOG.md:25 (raised by opus as its dc-01): Claim: 'a review list or judge naming only `top` still resolves, with a line saying which model `top` now stands for'. Reality: any review.judge that a configuration file sets is refused at the review stage. The calibration gate never clears in production: judgeGate returns false with no test fixture (internal/core/implement/loop/reviewset.go:520-526), and a non-bundled judge is refused (reviewset.go:635-644). Only a review list naming `top` resolves with the line (topNote, reviewset.go:880-895). The same contradiction is in commands/build.md:681-683 ('A review list or a judge naming `top` ... resolves'), which also says at :643-651 that a configured judge is refused. Fix: drop 'or judge'/'or a judge' in both places, e.g. 'a review list naming only `top` still resolves, with a line ...'.
failing.note: Fixed in R2: the changelog and release page were recomposed (payload-2/3) to say what the code does, and the brief and pages fixed in 2854547b and b456024c.

failing.summary: RELEASE.md:3 (raised by opus as its dc-02): Claim: 'A configuration file written with the old names (`middle`, `below`, `smallest`, or `top` for the strongest class) is refused naming the new ones'. Reality: `top` is refused only in a machine class map that sets `top` without `research` (oldClassFault, reviewset.go:850-869). A review list naming `top` is not refused: it runs the new `top`, the second class, with one stderr line (reviewset.go:880-895; CHANGELOG.md:25 states this correctly). A person relying on the refusal to find every old-name file keeps a `top` review list and gets the second-strongest model. Fix: '... (`middle`, `below` or `smallest`, or a class map that sets `top` without `research`) is refused naming the new ones; a review list naming `top` runs the second class and says so on one line.' The page carries quoted press-release text, so the intent's press release needs the same correction.
failing.note: Fixed in R2: the changelog and release page were recomposed (payload-2/3) to say what the code does, and the brief and pages fixed in 2854547b and b456024c.

failing.summary: CHANGELOG.md:27 (raised by opus as its dc-03): Claim: 'Bare, it changes nothing'. The same claim is in RELEASE.md:5 ('`abcd sweep` run bare changes nothing'). Reality: the bare sweep fetches origin's branches and the reservations first. The binary's Short says 'Writes only the fetch bare', the --apply flag help says 'without it the sweep changes nothing but the fetch', and commands/sweep.md:16 says 'it changes nothing but the fetch'. Fix: 'Bare, it changes nothing but its fetch of origin'.

failing.summary: CHANGELOG.md:29 (raised by opus as its dc-05): Claim: 'A release that fails any of those steps changes nothing and is reported once'. Reality (abcd drain --help, self-update paragraph): a release that fails the checks or the live launch is said once and not taken again. A failed read-only run is said once per reason and tried again at later checks. A network fault, rate limit or timeout while fetching, and a limit or outage during the live launch, are no verdict, and each check says so in one line. Fix: 'A release the checks or the live launch refuse changes nothing and is reported once'. (also raised by the docs-currency review at CHANGELOG.md:30 (the drain --drive self-update entry); RELEASE.md paragraph 3, folded here as one finding)
failing.note: Fixed in R2: the changelog and release page were recomposed (payload-2/3) to say what the code does, and the brief and pages fixed in 2854547b and b456024c.

failing.summary: CHANGELOG.md:37 (raised by opus as its dc-07): Claim: 'every session's land step waits until the cut is done'. Reality: `abcd land` pushes, arms and queues nothing and exits 3 while another session's release reservation holds (abcd land --help, release-hold paragraph and exit 3). The copy cutting the release lands through its own hold. Only a build or drain lane waits on the hold (internal/core/implement/loop/queue.go:482). Fix: 'every other session's landing holds until the cut is done: `abcd land` refuses with exit 3 and a lane waits'.
